objectives: Explain why Abraham sent his servant to his own kindred for Isaac's wife.
Describe the sign at the well and the character of Rebekah.
Explain the custom of Rebekah covering herself.
takeaways: Abraham would not take a wife for Isaac of the Canaanites; marrying into the other nations was never condoned (Tobit 4:12).
The law gives the reason: they will turn away thy son from following me (Deuteronomy 7:3-4).
The Lord sent His angel before the servant; Rebekah came before he had done praying: fair, a virgin, and kind.
Her family blessed her: let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them. The covenant narrows to her son Jacob.
Rebekah took a vail and covered herself as a sign of submission, the custom 1 Corinthians 11 goes into.
